Name: 日耀回忆·黑日之后
Name_en: Solar Memory - After the Black Sun
Name_ja: Solar Memory - After the Black Sun
Description:
特瑞厄斯
黑日之后，特瑞厄斯失去了真正的黎明，人们仍必须在灰暗天幕下计算明天。
Description_zh-Hant:
特瑞厄斯
黑日之后，特瑞厄斯失去了真正的黎明，人们仍必须在灰暗天幕下计算明天。
Description_en:
Terrius
After the Black Sun, Terrius lost the true dawn and still counted tomorrow beneath a scorched sky.
Description_ja:
Terrius
After the Black Sun, Terrius lost the true dawn and still counted tomorrow beneath a scorched sky.

Name: 日耀回忆·第二日轮
Description:
特瑞厄斯
白曜圣庭制造了第二日轮，用一轮不会升起也不会落下的人造太阳重新划分昼夜。
Description_zh-Hant:
特瑞厄斯
白曜圣庭制造了第二日轮，用一轮不会升起也不会落下的人造太阳重新划分昼夜。
Description_en:
Terrius
The White Radiance Court made the Second Sun, an artificial sun that divided day and night without rising or setting.
Description_ja:
Terrius
The White Radiance Court made the Second Sun, an artificial sun that divided day and night without rising or setting.

Name: 日耀回忆·圣女的日常
Description:
白曜圣庭
乌娜曾在长廊与医祷院之间行走，像是第二日轮最温柔的证明。
Description_zh-Hant:
白曜圣庭
乌娜曾在长廊与医祷院之间行走，像是第二日轮最温柔的证明。
Description_en:
White Radiance Court
Una once walked between corridors and wards as the gentlest proof of the Second Sun.
Description_ja:
White Radiance Court
Una once walked between corridors and wards as the gentlest proof of the Second Sun.

Name: 日耀回忆·被污染的光
Description:
白曜圣庭
颜色先从街区消失，随后一个人的姓名和痕迹被第二日轮的光悄然抹去。
Description_zh-Hant:
白曜圣庭
颜色先从街区消失，随后一个人的姓名和痕迹被第二日轮的光悄然抹去。
Description_en:
White Radiance Court
Color vanished first, then a person's name and traces were quietly erased by the light of the Second Sun.
Description_ja:
White Radiance Court
Color vanished first, then a person's name and traces were quietly erased by the light of the Second Sun.

Name: 日耀回忆·心哀与挣扎
Description:
圣轮
圣庭选择沉默，乌娜却听见空屋里的哭声与被抹去者最后的名字。
Description_zh-Hant:
圣轮
圣庭选择沉默，乌娜却听见空屋里的哭声与被抹去者最后的名字。
Description_en:
Sacred Wheel
The Court chose silence, while Una heard the crying in empty rooms and the final names of the erased.
Description_ja:
Sacred Wheel
The Court chose silence, while Una heard the crying in empty rooms and the final names of the erased.

Name: 日耀回忆·圣轮之上
Name_en: Solar Memory - Above the Sacred Wheel
Name_ja: Solar Memory - Above the Sacred Wheel
Description:
圣轮
乌娜戴上曜日冠冕，将被污染的光辉与众生祈祷一并收入体内。
Description_zh-Hant:
圣轮
乌娜戴上曜日冠冕，将被污染的光辉与众生祈祷一并收入体内。
Description_en:
Sacred Wheel
Una wore the Solar Crown and drew polluted light and every prayer into herself.
Description_ja:
Sacred Wheel
Una wore the Solar Crown and drew polluted light and every prayer into herself.

Description:
未知
翻开一页被灼痕封住的圣庭记录，余烬中有人仍在校准太阳。

Name: 日耀回忆
Description:
乌娜
本层日耀回忆在日轮残光中展开。确认套卡后，踏入首领连战。
Description_zh-Hant:
烏娜
本層日耀回憶在日輪殘光中展開。確認套卡後，踏入首領連戰。
Description_en:
Una
Solar Memory opens for this layer in the remaining sunlight. Review the deck, then enter the boss rush.
